guides.title: Create your XRP wallet
guides.description: In this quick XRP Mobile walkthrough you'll create a self custody XRP wallet on the XRP Ledger, back up your recovery phrase and set a PIN. XRP Mobile is a noncustodial wallet where you can buy, send, receive and swap XRP. Perfect if you're getting started with XRP or self custody.

guides.title: Receive XRP
guides.description: Learn how to receive XRP in XRP Mobile: open Receive, pick XRP, and share your deposit address or QR code. We also cover the XRP Ledger network warning and the 1 XRP minimum that activates a new account.

guides.title: Change your default currency
guides.description: Quick XRP Mobile tutorial: change the app's default currency from Settings. The selector shows each currency's code, name and symbol, and search matches names too, so switching from euros to Japanese Yen takes seconds.

guides.title: Import your Xaman account
guides.description: Step by step: import an existing XRP Ledger account into XRP Mobile using the 8 rows of Xaman secret numbers, set a PIN, and fund the address with the 1 XRP an account needs to activate on the ledger. Same address, same balance, and the keys stay on your phone. Never share your secret numbers with anyone.

guides.title: Activate your XRP account
guides.description: Every new XRP Ledger account needs 1 XRP before the ledger will hold it. In this XRP Mobile walkthrough you'll see where the activation card comes from, what the base reserve actually is, how to find your deposit address on the right network, and what changes the moment the funds land. Not financial advice.
